name: Ponzu Sauce
siboNotes: Traditional ponzu made with citrus juice and soy sauce is well-tolerated. Watch for added onion or garlic in commercial varieties.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels for added onion or garlic powder
Make homemade with yuzu/lemon juice, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and mirin
Use sparingly as it's high in sodium
Store in refrigerator and use within recommended timeframe
alternatives: Rice vinegar with a touch of maple syrup
Lemon juice with low-sodium soy sauce
nutritionalHighlights: Contains beneficial plant compounds from citrus
Provides umami flavor without added FODMAPs
